Предложи, как можно получше задать медиа, разные версии одного медиа и связь с постами (сейчас она практически через имена файлов, но их менять не планируется). Также хотелось бы уйти от загрузки списка файлов из файловой системы, так как страницу планируется хостить в GitHub Pages. Но страница на ASP.NET сайте останется, так что можно сделать проверку, все ли файлы из файловой системы, которые подгружаются по текущей логике, есть по новой логике, и сообщать (alert), если это не так.

@inject IWebHostEnvironment WebHostEnvironment
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "stairs2line archive";
    ViewData["Description"] = "Все найденные версии всех рисунков и анимаций stairs2line.";
    ViewData["ImagePreview"] = "/media/stairs2line/tumblr/143559403624_tumblr_o6dg5xA0UN1s4v84ho1_400.png";

    var wwwRootPath = WebHostEnvironment.WebRootPath;
    /*var files = Directory.GetFiles(System.IO.Path.Combine(wwwRootPath, "media", "stairs2line", "twitter"))
        .Concat(Directory.GetFiles(System.IO.Path.Combine(wwwRootPath, "media", "stairs2line", "tumblr")))
        .Concat(Directory.GetFiles(System.IO.Path.Combine(wwwRootPath, "media", "stairs2line", "pixiv")))
        .Concat(Directory.GetFiles(System.IO.Path.Combine(wwwRootPath, "media", "stairs2line", "other")));
    int offset = System.IO.Path.Combine(wwwRootPath, "media", "stairs2line").Length + 1;
    var filesStr = string.Join("`, `", files.Select(f => f[offset..]));*/
    var files = Directory.GetFiles(System.IO.Path.Combine(wwwRootPath, "media", "stairs2line", "twitter")).Select(path => "twitter/" + System.IO.Path.GetFileName(path))
        .Concat(Directory.GetFiles(System.IO.Path.Combine(wwwRootPath, "media", "stairs2line", "tumblr")).Select(path => "tumblr/" + System.IO.Path.GetFileName(path)))
        .Concat(Directory.GetFiles(System.IO.Path.Combine(wwwRootPath, "media", "stairs2line", "pixiv")).Select(path => "pixiv/" + System.IO.Path.GetFileName(path)))
        .Concat(Directory.GetFiles(System.IO.Path.Combine(wwwRootPath, "media", "stairs2line", "other")).Select(path => "other/" + System.IO.Path.GetFileName(path)));
    var filesStr = string.Join("`, `", files);
}

        { versions: [ { scope: "major", media: [ "HNf71eZbgAAUtI2", "147357899_p0" ] } ] },
    ];
    for (const post of posts) {
        // calculate twitter dates
        if (post.platform === "twitter") {
            const twitterEpoch = 1288834974657n;
            post.time = Number((BigInt(post.post) >> 22n) + twitterEpoch);
        }
        if (post.time > 2147483647) post.time /= 1000;
    }
    
    const basePath = "stairs2line";
    function getTwitterMediaTime(mediaId) {
        const twitterEpoch = 1288834974657n;

        // Convert base64url -> base64
        let b64 = mediaId.replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/");

        // Pad to multiple of 4
        while (b64.length % 4 !== 0) {
            b64 += "=";
        }

        // Decode to bytes
        const raw = atob(b64);
        const bytes = Uint8Array.from(raw, c => c.charCodeAt(0));

        if (bytes.length < 8) {
            throw new Error(`Media ID decoded to fewer than 8 bytes: ${mediaId}`);
        }

        // Twitter media IDs store the useful snowflake value in the first 8 bytes
        let snowflake = 0n;
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
            snowflake = (snowflake << 8n) | BigInt(bytes[i]);
        }

        const unixMs = (snowflake >> 22n) + twitterEpoch;
        return Number(unixMs);
    }

    function getMediaInfo(f) {
        const platform = f.substring(0, f.lastIndexOf('/'));
        let filename = f.substring(f.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
        const filepath = basePath + "/" + platform + "/" + filename;
        if (filename.length > 11 && filename[4] == '-' && filename[7] == '-' && filename[10] == '_') {
            filename = filename.substring(11);
        }
        const post = posts.find(p => (platform === "other" || p.platform == platform) && filename.startsWith(p.post));
        let mediaId = filename.substring(0, filename.lastIndexOf('.'));
        if (platform === "twitter" && '0' <= mediaId[0] && mediaId[0] <= '9' || platform === "tumblr") {
            // 437560548058599425_BhKHAAsCEAAV9B4
            // 611514892709855232_CHyJFpdWsAAuuUb_hatrangam
            mediaId = mediaId.substring(mediaId.indexOf('_') + 1);
            if (platform === "tumblr") {
                // 111275517544_tumblr_njx4jo5WdP1s4v84ho1_r2_400
                // 806000851033456640_eba8736e9dacf17be929d57f0371f94a19737731
                mediaId = mediaId.substring(mediaId.indexOf('_') + 1);
            }
        }
        let mediaTime = post ? post.time : (platform === "twitter" ? getTwitterMediaTime(mediaId) : null);
        return {
            filepath: filepath,
            mediaId: mediaId,
            post: post,
            attrGroup: "",
            attrMedia: mediaTime ? `${mediaTime}_${mediaId}` : ""
        };
    }
    
    const filenames = [`@Html.Raw(filesStr)`];
    const medias = filenames.map(f => getMediaInfo(f));

    const mediaIdsGroups = {};
    for (const group of mediaGroups) {
        for (const version of group.versions) {
            for (const mediaId of version.media) {
                mediaIdsGroups[mediaId] = { group: group, version: version };
            }
        }
    }
    console.log(mediaIdsGroups)
    // calculate group version dates and choose single media to display
    for (const mediaId of Object.keys(mediaIdsGroups)) {
        const groupInfo = mediaIdsGroups[mediaId];
        if (groupInfo.version.time > 2147483647) groupInfo.version.time /= 1000;
        if (groupInfo.group.time > 2147483647) groupInfo.group.time /= 1000;

        let post = undefined;
        let media = medias.find(x => x.mediaId === mediaId);
        if (media) {
            post = media.post;
        }
        else {
            // all tumblr media files must exist
            if ('0' <= mediaId[0] && mediaId[0] <= '9') {
                // assume pixiv
                const postId = getInt(mediaId, 0);
                post = posts.find(p => p.platform === "pixiv" && p.post === postId);
                if (!post) console.log(`Could not find post for ${mediaId} to provide platform link! post id = ${postId}`);
            }
            else {
                // assume twitter, search in 12 hours window (images are uploading before the post)
                let time = getTwitterMediaTime(mediaId);
                if (time > 2147483647) time /= 1000;
                post = posts.find(p => p.platform === "twitter" && time <= p.time && p.time <= time + 60 * 60 * 12);
                if (!post) console.log(`Could not find post for ${mediaId} to provide platform link! ${time} <= time <= ${time + 60 * 60 * 3}`);
            }
        }
        if (!groupInfo.version.medias) groupInfo.version.medias = [];
        if (!post || !groupInfo.version.medias.some(x => x.post && x.post.post === post.post)) {
            groupInfo.version.medias.push(media ? media : { post: post, mediaId: mediaId });
        }

        let mediaTime = post && post.time ? post.time : null;
        if (!mediaTime && mediaId.length === 15 && 'A' <= mediaId[0] && mediaId[0] <= 'Z') {
            // all tumblr posts must exist and specify time
            mediaTime = getTwitterMediaTime(mediaId);
            if (mediaTime > 2147483647) mediaTime /= 1000;
        } 
        if (!mediaTime) {
            console.log("Media version is not dated! " + mediaId);
            continue;
        }
        
        if (!groupInfo.version.time) groupInfo.version.time = mediaTime;
        else groupInfo.version.time = Math.min(groupInfo.version.time, mediaTime);
        if (groupInfo.version.time === mediaTime) groupInfo.version.timeSource = media;
        
        if (!groupInfo.group.time) groupInfo.group.time = groupInfo.version.time;
        else groupInfo.group.time = Math.min(groupInfo.group.time, groupInfo.version.time);
        if (groupInfo.group.time === mediaTime) groupInfo.group.timeSource = media;
    }
    for (const media of medias) {
        const groupInfo = mediaIdsGroups[media.mediaId];
        if (!groupInfo) {
            console.log("Media has not group! " + media.filepath);
            continue;
        }
        if (!groupInfo.version.time) {
            console.log("Media version is not dated! " + media.filepath);
        }
        else {
            media.attrMedia = `${groupInfo.version.time}_${media.mediaId}`;
        }
        if (!groupInfo.group.time) {
            console.log("Media group is not dated! " + media.filepath);
            continue;
        }
        const groupMediaId = groupInfo.group.timeSource ? groupInfo.group.timeSource.mediaId : "";
        const attrMedia = media.attrMedia ? media.attrMedia : "|" + media.mediaId;
        media.attrGroup = `${groupInfo.group.time}_${groupMediaId}_${attrMedia}`;
    }

    const leadVersions = [];
    for (const media of medias) {
        const groupInfo = mediaIdsGroups[media.mediaId];
        const leadVersion = !groupInfo ? null : groupInfo.version.medias.find(mediaId => medias.some(m => m === mediaId)) ;
        if (leadVersion && leadVersion.mediaId !== media.mediaId) {
            //console.log("Duplicate of " + leadVersion.mediaId + ": " + media.filepath);
            continue;
        }

        const versionMedias = groupInfo && groupInfo.version.medias ? groupInfo.version.medias : [media];
        leadVersions.push({ leadMedia: media, versionMedias: versionMedias, scope: groupInfo ? groupInfo.version.scope : "major" });
    }

    function getPlatformsInfo(versionMedias) {
        const result = [];
        for (const versionMedia of versionMedias) {
            const mediaId = versionMedia.mediaId;
            let post = versionMedia.post;
            let alive = post ? post.alive : false;
            let href = ``;
            let favicon = ``;
            if (!post && mediaId.length === 15 || post && post.platform === "twitter") {
                favicon = `/media/stairs2line/misc/twitter-icon-free-png.webp`;
                if (post) {
                    href = `https://twitter.com/${post.user ? post.user : "stairs2line"}/status/${post.post}`;
                }
                else {
                    href = `https://pbs.twimg.com/media/${mediaId}?format=png&name=large`;
                }
            }
            if (!post) { post = {}; }
            if (post.platform === "pixiv") {
                favicon = `/media/stairs2line/misc/pixiv_favicon20250122.ico`;
                href = `https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/${post.post}`;
            }
            if (post.platform === "tumblr") {
                favicon = `/media/stairs2line/misc/tumblr_favicon.ico`;
                href = `https://michinoku800.tumblr.com/post/${post.post}`;
            }
            if (post.platform === "piapro") {
                favicon = `/media/stairs2line/misc/blog-piapro_favicon.ico`;
                href = post.href;
            }
            if (post.platform === "snowmiku.com") {
                favicon = `/media/stairs2line/misc/snowmiku_favicon.ico`;
                href = post.href;
            }
            if (post.platform === "instagram") {
                favicon = `/media/stairs2line/misc/instagram_favicon.png`;
                href = `https://www.instagram.com/p/${post.post}/`; // https://www.instagram.com/stairs2line/
            }
            if (post.platform === "pixivFANBOX") {
                favicon = `/media/stairs2line/misc/Pixiv_FANBOX_(Icon).svg`;
                href = post.href;
            }
            
            let mediaTime = post ? post.time : null;
            if (!mediaTime && versionMedias.length === 1) {
                let groupInfo = mediaIdsGroups[mediaId];
                mediaTime = groupInfo && groupInfo.version.time ? groupInfo.version.time : null;
            }
            result.push({ platform: post.platform, favicon: favicon, alive: alive, href: href, media: versionMedia, time: mediaTime });
        }
        result.sort(function (a, b) { return !b.time ? -1 : !a.time ? 1 : a.time - b.time; });
        return result;
    }

    for (const t of leadVersions) {
        const leadMedia = t.leadMedia;
        const versionMedias = t.versionMedias;
        const scope = t.scope;
        let attr = `fullname="${leadMedia.mediaId}" version-type="${scope}"`;
        if (leadMedia.attrGroup) attr += ` group="${leadMedia.attrGroup}"`;
        if (leadMedia.attrMedia) attr += ` piece="${leadMedia.attrMedia}"`;

        const $media = createMedia(leadMedia.filepath, `onclick="mediaViewer.show(this, mediaProvider)"`);
        const $card = $(`<div class="media-card align-items-center hidden" ${attr}></div>`);
        const $wrapper = $(`<div class="media-with-links"></div>`);
        const $platforms = $(`<div class="platforms"></div>`);
        for (const platformInfo of getPlatformsInfo(versionMedias)) {
            if (!platformInfo.favicon) continue;

            $platforms.append(`<a href="${platformInfo.href}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="fit-media ${platformInfo.alive ? "": "inactive-platform"}">
                <img src="${platformInfo.favicon}" />
            </a>`);
        }
        $wrapper.append($media);
        $wrapper.append($platforms);
        $card.append(`<div></div>`).append($wrapper).append(`<div></div>`);
        $container.append($card);
    }
    var postTimestamps = posts.map(p => p.time).filter(t => t);
    var dateRange = { min: Math.min(...postTimestamps), max: Math.max(...postTimestamps) };
    for (let year = new Date(dateRange.min * 1000).getUTCFullYear(); year <= new Date(dateRange.max * 1000).getUTCFullYear(); year++) {
        let startYearTime = new Date(`${year}-01-01 00:00:00 +0000`).getTime() / 1000;
        let endYearTime = new Date(`${year}-12-31 23:59:59 +0000`).getTime() / 1000;
        $container.append(`<h4 class="year-label year-start" version-type="major" group="${startYearTime}" piece="${startYearTime}">${year}</h4>`);
        $container.append(`<h4 class="year-label year-end" version-type="major" group="${endYearTime}" piece="${endYearTime}">${year}</h4>`);
    }

    function resort(sortAttr, order) {
        updateSortIcons(sortAttr, order);
        $container.find(`.year-start`).toggleClass("hidden", sortAttr === "group" || order !== "asc");
        $container.find(`.year-end`).toggleClass("hidden", sortAttr === "group" || order === "asc");

        let $children = $container.children().get();
        let orderSign = order === "asc" ? 1 : -1;
        $children.sort(function(a, b) {
            let an = $(a).attr(sortAttr), bn = $(b).attr(sortAttr);
            if (!bn && an) return -1;
            if (!an && bn) return 1;
            if (an > bn) return orderSign;
            if (an < bn) return -orderSign;

            an = $(a).attr("fullname");
            bn = $(b).attr("fullname");
            if (!bn && an) return -1;
            if (!an && bn) return 1;
            if (an > bn) return 1;
            if (an < bn) return -1;

            return 0;
        });

        $.each($children, function(idx, item) {
            $container.append(item);
        });

        updateHeaders();
    }

    function updateHeaders() {
        $(`#undatedMediaHeader`).toggleClass("hidden", $(`#undatedMediaHeader`).nextAll(`div:not(.hidden)`).length === 0);
    }

    function updateSortIcons(sortAttr, order) {
        const orderIcon = order === "desc" ? `🢁` : `🡻`;
        $(`.sort-option`).find(`span`).text(orderIcon);
        const isChecked = sortAttr === "group";
        $(`.sort-group`).find(`span`).text(isChecked ? "▣" : "☐");
        $(`.sort-group`).toggleClass("selected", isChecked);
    }
    function updateFilterIcons(filter) {
        $(`.filter-option`).each(function (_, element) {
            const option = $(element);
            const selected = filter === option.attr("filter-option");
            if (selected) {
                option.toggleClass("selected", true);
                const s = option.find(`span`);
                s.text(`▣`);
            } else {
                option.toggleClass("selected", false);
            }
        });
        let text = $(`.filter-option.selected`).text();
        text = text.substring(0, text.length - 2);
        $(`.filter-dropdown button`).text(text);
    }

    function refilter(filter) {
        updateFilterIcons(filter);

        $(`.media-card[version-type="top"]`).toggleClass("hidden", false);
        $(`.media-card[version-type="major"]`).toggleClass("hidden", filter === "top");
        $(`.media-card[version-type="sketchy"]`).toggleClass("hidden", filter === "top" || filter === "major");
        $(`.media-card[version-type="decorative"]`).toggleClass("hidden", filter !== "decorative");

        updateHeaders();
    }

    function onSortClick(el) {
        const $el = $(el);
        let order = $el.find(`span`).text() === `🢁` ? "asc" : "desc";
        let attr = $(".sort-group").hasClass("selected") ? "group" : "piece";
        resort(attr, order);
    }
    function onSortGroupClick(el) {
        const $el = $(el);
        const isChecked = $el.hasClass("selected");
        let attr = !isChecked ? "group" : "piece";
        let order = $(".sort-option").find(`span`).text() === `🢁` ? "desc" : "asc";
        resort(attr, order);
    }

    function onFilterClick(el) {
        const $el = $(el);
        refilter($el.attr("filter-option"));
    }

    function getInt(s, indexFrom) {
        let i = indexFrom;
        while (i < s.length && '0' <= s[i] && s[i] <= '9') i++;
        return s.substring(indexFrom, i);
    }

    resort("group", "asc");
    refilter("top");

    class LocalMediaProvider {
        constructor(elementSelector, mediaSelector) {
            this.elementSelector = elementSelector;
            this.mediaSelector = mediaSelector;
        }

        getNext(el, callback) {
            const $el = $(el);
            callback($el.closest(this.elementSelector).nextAll(this.elementSelector).first().find(this.mediaSelector)[0]);
        }

        getPrev(el, callback) {
            const $el = $(el);
            callback($el.closest(this.elementSelector).prevAll(this.elementSelector).first().find(this.mediaSelector)[0]);
        }
    }

    function updateModalFooter(el) {
        const $el = $(el);
        const src = $el.attr("src");
        const displayMedia = medias.find(x => src.endsWith(x.filepath));
        const groupInfo = mediaIdsGroups[displayMedia.mediaId];
        $(`.modal-subtext`).empty();
        let versionMedias = groupInfo ? groupInfo.version.medias : [displayMedia];
        for (const platformInfo of getPlatformsInfo(versionMedias)) {
            let dateStr = "Unknown date";
            if (platformInfo.time) {
                const date = new Date(platformInfo.time * 1000);
                function p(n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : n; }
                dateStr = p(date.getFullYear()) + "-" + p(date.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + p(date.getDate()) + " "
                    + p(date.getHours()) + ":" + p(date.getMinutes()) + ":" + p(date.getSeconds());
            }
            let postStr = `unknown source`;
            if (platformInfo.href) postStr =
                `<a href="${platformInfo.href}" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" class="modal-mini-button ${platformInfo.alive ? "": "inactive-platform"}">
                    <img class="favicon-mini" src="${platformInfo.favicon}"/>
                </a>`;
            else if (platformInfo.time) dateStr = "Before " + dateStr;
            $(`.modal-subtext`).append(`<div>${dateStr} at ${postStr}</div>`);
        }
    }
    
    let mediaProvider = null;
    let mediaViewer = null;
    $(document).ready(function() {
        mediaProvider = new LocalMediaProvider(`.media-card:not(.hidden)`, `.media-with-links > img, .media-with-links > video`);
        mediaViewer = new MediaViewer(`#mediaModal`, (el) => { showFullSizeCopy(el); updateModalFooter(el); });
    });
</script>
